instruments.notes: LaTex oil collar based on 2,293 Bbls per month (monthly volume only; not converted). Three-year program beginning April 1, 1995; terminated May 15, 1997 at a cost of $1.128 million total for oil and gas agreements. Dedicated annual oil volumes stated: 324,288 Bbls FY1996, 279,828 Bbls FY1997, 170,344 Bbls FY1998.
instruments.evidence_quote:
Under the commodity collar transaction, oil prices were fixed at
     a floor of $16.50/Bbl and a ceiling of $19.82/Bbl based on 2,293 BBLS per
     month.

instruments.notes: LaTex gas swap based on 139,412 MMBTU per month (monthly volume only; not converted). Three-year program beginning April 1, 1995; terminated May 15, 1997. Direction is inferred from pre-sale at a fixed price.
instruments.evidence_quote:
Under the commodity swap transaction, the price of gas was fixed at
     $1.806 MMBTU based on 139,412 MMBTU per month.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Lender-required price protection program (LaTex collar/swap, terminated May 1997); new Oct 1997 purchased puts (floors) protect against price declines on over 90% of monthly volumes, keeping upside.
